issues.title: [Backlog] Alert when stock falls below a threshold
issues.body:
Planned for a later iteration.

Stores want a warning before a synthetic medicine reaches zero stock. The threshold and the notification channel are not decided yet.

Synthetic workshop backlog item. Do not implement in Lab 2.

issues.title: [Backlog] Expire unconfirmed reservations after 30 minutes
issues.body:
Planned for a later iteration.

Unconfirmed reservations currently hold stock indefinitely. Expiry needs a clock and a release rule, which the service does not have yet.

Synthetic workshop backlog item. Do not implement in Lab 2.
